settings.title: agenticnights Settings
blackout.title: Blackout
blackout.about: Hides what's on the screen when you're not using your Mac, like a screen saver. Agents can still see and use the screen.
blackout.delay: Start after this many minutes of inactivity
blackout.delayHint: Keyboard or mouse input restarts the wait.
blackout.end: Click to end the blackout. Keyboard input isn't blocked.
blackout.requireAuth: Require Touch ID or password to end the blackout
blackout.requireAuthHint: Uses Touch ID or your Mac login password.
blackout.requireAuthOffHint: Turning this off also requires Touch ID or your password. Other settings change without authentication.
blackout.disableAuthReason: turn off authentication for ending the blackout
blackout.voiceOver: Turning on VoiceOver during a blackout locks your Mac.
blackout.dim: The built-in display is dimmed during a blackout.
blackout.shortcutHint: Blacks out the screen or ends the blackout.
sleep.title: Sleep Prevention
sleep.enableHint: Keeps your Mac from sleeping automatically.
sleep.displayHint: Agents that use the screen need this. When the display turns off, macOS may lock the screen.
sleep.durationHint: Counted from when you turn it on. Using the keyboard or mouse doesn't change the end time. When time is up, macOS settings apply again.
icon.title: Menu Bar Icon
icon.toggleSleep: Turn sleep prevention on or off
error.minutes: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
error.shortcut: This shortcut is unavailable. Choose another one.
settings.shortcutHint: ⌘, ⌥ or ⌃ + A–Z, 0–9 or F1–F20. Esc cancels recording.
settings.shortcutInvalid: Use ⌘, ⌥ or ⌃ with A–Z, 0–9 or F1–F20.
startup.title: Startup
startup.hint: Starts agenticnights when you log in, including after a restart or when macOS ends your session. Manage it in System Settings › General › Login Items.
startup.approval: Waiting for approval in System Settings › General › Login Items.
startup.unavailable: macOS cannot register this copy as a login item. Install the app in Applications.
update.endBlackout: End the blackout before checking for updates.
